annotations.title: Get a collection with ranked members

description: Fetch one published collection by slug with its ranked member companies: name, tier, cohort, open-role count, location, stage, investors, and which functions/cities they're hiring in. Members are paginated (100 per page). Follow up with get_company or search_jobs (company filter) for a specific member's roles.

slug.description: Collection slug from list_collections, e.g. "ai-infra" or "new-york".

name: get_collection
